article.intro: Good grunge band names sound like something left out in the rain: Mudhoney, Screaming Trees, Candlebox. This **grunge band name generator** makes band names, singer names and album titles in that early-90s style, from jammed-together compounds like Sludgegarden to blunt one-word records.

sections.heading: Eight good grunge band names
sections.content:
All eight came from the generator:

  • Sludgegarden: two words jammed together, one of them dirty.
  • Siltbox: short, damp and a bit ugly, as grunge should be.
  • Crowbar Daisy: something hard next to something pretty.
  • Melting Kites: an adjective and a plural noun, like Screaming Trees.
  • Church of the Slug: a grand building, ruined by what's in it.
  • Dogwater: a word nobody would want on a T-shirt, which is the point.
  • Wetter Than Church: an album title with a dry joke in it.
  • Loud Apathy: a record title that sums up the whole scene.

sections.heading: How grunge named itself
sections.content:
Grunge came out of Seattle in the late 1980s, much of it through Sub Pop, the label Bruce Pavitt and Jonathan Poneman set up there. Nirvana's Nevermind and Pearl Jam's Ten, both from 1991, took it worldwide.

The names were deliberately unglamorous:

  • Compounds: Soundgarden named themselves after a wind-powered sculpture in Seattle, A Sound Garden, which hums in the breeze. The generator builds the same kind: Cedarhole, Puddlejump.
  • B-movie borrowing: Mudhoney took their name from a Russ Meyer film.
  • An adjective and a plural: Rotten Dogs, Sinking Teeth.

Choose Stage name for plain, real-sounding singers like Dana Kessel (grunge didn't do glam pseudonyms), or Album title for records like Bowl of Rust and Ugly Weather.

sections.heading: Using a grunge name
sections.content:
• Make it slightly off-putting. Grunge names were a reaction against the polished hair metal before them.
  • Use the weather. Rain, rust, moss and mud are all over the Pacific Northwest, and all over grunge.
  • Search before you commit. Look the name up on Spotify, Bandcamp and YouTube, and check the social handles are free. Two acts with one name confuse fans and streaming services alike.

faqs.question: What are good grunge band names?
faqs.answer: Damp, ugly and a bit sarcastic: Sludgegarden, Siltbox, Crowbar Daisy, Melting Kites or Church of the Slug. Compounds of two words, one of them dirty, are the classic grunge shape.

faqs.question: How did grunge bands get their names?
faqs.answer: Often from odd places: Soundgarden from a humming wind sculpture in Seattle, Mudhoney from a Russ Meyer film. The point was to sound unglamorous.

faqs.question: Are these real grunge bands?
faqs.answer: No, they're new names in the early-90s Seattle style. Check Spotify and Bandcamp before you use one, as plenty of bands still play this kind of music.
